title: Kazakhstan tightens checks on the Kyrgyz border
notes: Road freight queued for days. Sources do not report fuel deliveries directly; most Russian fuel reaches Kyrgyzstan by rail through Kazakhstan. End date is the last report found (500 trucks queued on 2 Dec 2017).

title: Russia bans gasoline exports
notes: EAEU supplies under intergovernmental agreements were excluded (RFE/RL).

title: Russia bans diesel exports
notes: Pipeline diesel via ports resumed 6 Oct 2023 if half was sold domestically. Controls on diesel by rail continued after that (S&P 17 Nov 2023); their end was not found.

title: Russia bans gasoline exports for six months; suspended in May
notes: EAEU members exempt. Suspended from 20 May to 31 Jul 2024.

title: Russia reinstates the gasoline export ban
notes: End date uncertain: Enerdata gave end of October and Meduza reported an early lifting in late Nov 2024. Continued EAEU exemption is assumed and not confirmed in these sources.

title: Russia bans gasoline exports again; extended to January 2027
notes: Producers banned from Aug 2025; all exporters from 1 Oct 2025; extended to 28 Feb 2026, 31 Jul 2026 and 31 Jan 2027. Short gaps for producers in early 2026 are not coded. Intergovernmental supplies stay exempt, but deliveries to Kyrgyzstan still fell in 2026 (see KGZ_2026_SUPPLY_CRISIS).

title: Russia restricts diesel exports by resellers, later also by producers
notes: Reseller ban runs to Jan 2027. A producer ban applied in Aug-Oct 2026 and was partly lifted in Oct 2026. Scope differs between sources.

title: Duty-free Russian fuel quota for 2023 nears exhaustion
notes: A single press report. End assumed at the end of the quota year.

title: Kyrgyz regulator warns of price rises as Russian fuel imports fall
notes: Antimonopoly service statement of 24 Oct 2025: prices could rise 15% for lack of imports from Russia. Follows Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries from Aug 2025. Single source; onset month uncertain.

title: Kyrgyz gasoline and diesel shortage as Russian deliveries fall
notes: Russia stopped all gasoline exports from 30 Jun 2026; AI-95 and diesel ran short at some stations. Moscow agreed to supply 100 kt a month to the end of 2026. Comtrade has no Kyrgyz data for Jun-Jul 2026.

title: Kyrgyzstan bans fuel exports indefinitely
notes: Policy response to the shortage. Import restrictions were relaxed at the same time.

title: Kyrgyzstan regulates fuel prices and keeps imports duty-free
notes: Start date from secondary reporting of the regulation; check against the Cabinet resolution.

title: Kazakhstan bans gasoline and diesel exports by road (rolling orders)
notes: Six-month orders since Nov 2021 with gaps (one ended 21 May 2022; another started 12 Jul 2022). Applies to EAEU partners too. Affected countries are the road-connected neighbours; size of the effect is unknown.

title: COVID-19 lockdowns cut fuel demand
notes: Global trough in April 2020. Country timing varies; window is approximate.

title: Russian invasion of Ukraine and the 2022 price shock
notes: Price and trade-route shock. End date is an assumption for stratification.

title: US-Iran war closes the Strait of Hormuz
notes: Traffic largely stopped within days; ceasefire 8 Apr 2026; renewed fighting from Jul 2026.

title: EU embargo on Russian refined products
notes: Forces a change of supplier rather than a drop in volume. Announcement date is the sixth sanctions package.

title: Contaminated crude in the Druzhba pipeline
notes: Crude input to refiners, so product imports may rise rather than fall. Southern branch partly restored by 21 May 2019; country dates differ between sources.

title: Strikes on Druzhba halt crude flows to Hungary and Slovakia
notes: Three attacks in Aug 2025; flows offline for about a week. A short halt in Mar 2025 is not coded.

title: Druzhba damage halts crude to Hungary and Slovakia
notes: Further halts reported in Mar and Aug 2026 are not coded yet.

title: Hungary caps petrol and diesel prices at HUF 480
notes: Restricted to private vehicles and farm use from Aug 2022.

title: Hungarian stations run dry under the price cap
notes: MOL blamed foreign suppliers cutting shipments under the cap, plus refinery maintenance.

title: Low Rhine water cuts Swiss fuel imports; diesel stocks released
notes: Release of 30,000 m3 of diesel from compulsory stocks. River levels were low from late summer; window is approximate.

title: Low Rhine water; Swiss compulsory stocks cut 6.5%
notes: Stock cut ran from 25 Jul to early Sep 2022; further release in Aug 2022.

title: Low Rhine water; Swiss compulsory stocks released
notes: Gasoline and diesel withdrawals from 8 Sep 2026; another diesel release from 23 Oct 2026.

title: Record-low Paraguay River slows fuel imports
notes: Barges loaded to about 80% and one Petropar dock out of use. Low water also in 2019-2021 without a documented fuel shortage.

title: Bolivian diesel supply cut by Arica port closure and low rivers
notes: Diesel supply down 22%. Single source.

title: Bolivian fuel shortages from lack of US dollars
notes: Road blockades in Nov 2024 cut shipments; repeated shortages through 2025; state took control of YPFB on 1 Sep 2026. Start date is the first documented month, not the onset of the dollar shortage.

title: Laos fuel shortage as the kip falls
notes: Queues from Nov 2021; pumps in Vientiane ran dry from 16 May 2022; USD 102m sourced for fuel imports in June 2022.

title: Laos fuel pumps run dry again
notes: Outside the Lao Comtrade span, which ends in Dec 2023.

title: Zimbabwe fuel shortages from lack of hard currency
notes: Price up about 150% on 12 Jan 2019; queues still reported in Jul 2019 (Al Jazeera, 29 Jul 2019).

title: Zambian fuel shortages from scarce foreign exchange
notes: Outside the Zambian Comtrade span, which ends in Dec 2023.

title: Zambia declares a fuel supply emergency
notes: Linked to the Hormuz closure. Outside the Zambian Comtrade span.

title: Burundi fuel shortages from the dollar crunch
notes: Importers stopped buying for lack of foreign currency.

title: Weeks-long fuel queues in Burundi
notes: Chronic shortage; reserves covered 0.7 months of imports in Dec 2023. Start date approximate.

title: US sanctions on NIS halt Serbia's only refinery
notes: Crude supply cut, so Serbia must import more products. Status after Dec 2025 not checked.

title: Explosion at the Litvinov complex cuts Czech refining
notes: Refinery throughput cut to a minimum as a precaution; gasoline and diesel output still limited in Sep 2015.
